scope: StaticKV direct formula / source-v2 public columns / block resident v2: ragged Read/Full grouping, parameter-bank shapes and raw snapshots.

notation.T: initial bank columns plus current-window columns in dense direct formula
notation.Q_i: maximum actual query count across B samples for node i; padded to at least 1
notation.K_i: maximum actual bank count across B samples for node i; padded to at least 1
notation.G: number of nodes in one public compatible group
notation.P: one parameter role matrix element count; unrelated to number of ports

direct.schedule: StaticKV.__call__: one region loop; _sources topology/edge loops occur in construction. _aggregate loops only predecessor-region source blocks during forward.
direct.projection: project: X[N,B*L,I] with W[N,O,I], or one shared GEMM if every weight object is identical. Source axis S replaces N for source MLP. No B*L replication of W.
direct.partial_aliases: All-shared detection only. Other partial aliases remain stacked once per node/source slot.
direct.raw: append holds one [N,B,T,...] bank with validity/timestamps; read/full share it. No full raw prefix per query. Terminal filters actual validity/last-positive-write expiry. Explicit decode loops region/node/sample only at boundary.
direct.read: Q[N,B,L,ds], K/V[N,B,T,ds], score[N,B,L,T]. QK shared across short/long channels. Sum uses summaries only.
direct.full: Q/K/V shaped [N,B,H,L-or-T,d/H]; all allocated N*B*L rows execute, then support mask. Heads share matmul batch, but rotations still loop H.
direct.call_count_conditions: Matrix calls, not all ATen operators or hardware kernels. Excludes Describe heads, source adaptation, allocation, normalization, packing and decoding.
direct.semantic_scope: Declared output/raw numerical projection only. Dense masked Full does not by itself certify production None/zero roots or complete intermediate event observations.

public_columns_source_v2.preparation_groups: Key includes actual total positive write rows, d/rank/ds, dtype/device; 4 matrix calls per nonempty group. Per-node validation, normalization and raw assembly remain.
public_columns_source_v2.read_groups: Key: KV config, regional config, Read mode, dtype/device, (B,Q_i), (B,K_i); split again by workspace budget. This does not require identical full ragged distributions.
public_columns_source_v2.full_groups: Only positive-control rows. Key: KV config, dtype/device, selected (B,Q_i), bank (B,K_i), then workspace. Different selected maxima or history lengths split groups; singletons use node implementation.
public_columns_source_v2.group_count: G_read/G_full are sums of actual key-equivalence classes after budget splitting, not fixed 90/159 constants. Per region 0..N nonempty Full groups and 1..N nonempty Read groups, depending on actual requests.
public_columns_source_v2.host_work: Per-node control nonzero/host row IDs, positive-memory flag host transfer, padded indices, normalization/stats/features and node/field output reverse index. Numerical matrices do not loop each token.
public_columns_source_v2.projection: linear_blocks packs X[G,B*Q,I], W[G,O,I], performs BMM; all-identical aliases use one matrix. VJP dW = Gbar^T X contracts B*Q and returns [G,O,I], not [G*B*Q,O,I].
public_columns_source_v2.raw: Actual positive writes form one per-node ragged bank. _queries/query_inputs pads needed fields to [B,K_i,width] and forms weights/ages [B,Q_i,K_i], not raw [B,Q_i,K_i,width]. Read and Full each gather the bank again; cross-node contraction packing adds copies.
public_columns_source_v2.read_calls: Sum: 2 contractions plus current summary = 3/group. Qry with no frequency and nonempty memory: 3 projections + short(QK,PV) + long(QK,PV) + current summary = 8/group. QK is repeated for short/long. Common-origin positional path shares QK, nominally 7/group. Literal relative fallback does pairwise elementwise rotations/dot instead, so not the same call expression.
public_columns_source_v2.full_calls: Nominal 7/group with positive memory and ordinary/common-origin contraction, 4/group when no memory: Q + QK + PV + out/gate/up/down. Head dimension batches inside contractions; per-head rotary work remains.
public_columns_source_v2.source_v2: Exact regional-call-local identity is actual content Tensor identity plus complete ordered parameter slots, alpha, epsilon. After reuse, shape/budget-compatible requests use 2 source MLP matmuls/group, plus 2 factor matmuls for adapted sources. Old 2*A physical-source count is no longer current.
public_columns_source_v2.tradeoff: Exact-size grouping is current engineering policy. Padding/bucketing broader groups is possible with support-aware VJP and original int64 visibility; it exchanges extra arithmetic for fewer submissions.

block_resident_v2.schedule: Block B*L region programs keep host submission stages bounded, but local helper implementations retain legacy row-oriented layouts. Low outer call count is not a proof of efficient arithmetic/storage.
block_resident_v2.lowering: block_settle_model assigns node_owners=n and stacks one local role bank per region node; true canonical parameter aliases are preserved for final gradient ownership, but not compressed into a single execution bank.
block_resident_v2.projection_multi_bank: weighted_projection banks>1 gathers W to [R,O,I], materializes transpose [R,I,O], then BMM [R,1,I]@[R,I,O]. Parameter VJP builds [R,O,I] outer products then reduces owners. Saved matrix+transpose alone use 8*R*O*I FP32 bytes, versus 8*N*O*I for node blocks; ratio B*L.
block_resident_v2.projection_single_bank: banks==1 has actual full-block GEMM/VJP and matrix_rows=1. This does not cover most node-private banks and is bypassed by Update pre-gather when R>1.
block_resident_v2.update: weighted_kv_update pre-gathers base/left/right/summary to [R,...], passes row_ids and saved rows into four projections. Even one original bank becomes R projection banks. VJP first reduces row-owned projection outputs, then original parameter owners. Repeated normalization of u is requested for base/right/summary.
block_resident_v2.heads: weighted_head always gathers both MLP matrices/biases to each row, even original banks==1; forward 2 per-row BMMs, backward 2 per-row outer products plus owner reduction. Applies to Describe score/match heads and region context/query heads.
block_resident_v2.raw_storage: old and proposal each [R,F_C]/[R,I_C]; final [B*N,F_C]/[B*N,I_C]; mapping [2,R,C], plus copied initial integer state and one-entry write tape. Major forward storage is 8*R*F_C + 16*R*I_C + 16*R*C FP32/int64 bytes before final/writes/windows.
block_resident_v2.raw_execution: Sequence wrapper uses only GetBlockIdx()==0 and host launches one block. Math loops B -> N -> L; copies complete old/proposal capacity, updates mappings, rematerializes ragged fields. VJP likewise one block; for each connected snapshot field scans all prior writes, worst O(B*N*L^2*field_count) structural work, plus numerical raw adjoint traffic.
block_resident_v2.read0: block_kv_local copies bound initial [B*N,...] to [B*L*N,...] by index_select; binding initial is correct, full per-frame copy is representation cost.
block_resident_v2.window: weighted_kv_window always materializes keys/values/summaries [R,C,width] plus two weight/decay channels, ages and mapping. Sum only consumes summaries; qry/Full do not consume summary values; these unused field copies are current helper interface costs.
block_resident_v2.read_qry: Q input [R,d]; K/V input [R*C,d], hence multi-bank matrices [R*C,ds,d] and transposes. Same history entries are projected again for each querying frame. Short/long duplicate values/logits/lengths/present to 2R then one pooled BMM. Nominal 5 Mem matmul calls (Q,K,V,QK,batched PV), plus Describe current-summary projection; fewer calls than direct does not mean less arithmetic or memory.
block_resident_v2.read_sum: One batched short/long pool matmul after duplicating summaries to [2R,C,ds]. No query parameters, but full raw/window field layout remains.
block_resident_v2.full: Q/out/gate/up/down each use row projection; heads loop in C++ for rotary/QK/pool. Nominal 5+2H matrix calls per regional block, versus 7 when H is batched. Allocated R*C work remains even when mask suppresses semantic activity.
necessary: Original int64 visibility, timestamps and last-write expiry
Actual exact terminal raw state and checkpoint decoding
Independent nonzero/connected-zero/disconnected roots and parameter aliases
Device-side dynamic support/selection and online advancement
not_mathematically_required: Float raw cache copied for every frame
History K/V projected anew for every query
Weight matrices copied per input row and per-row parameter outer products
Serial single-block execution across independent B/N owners
Repeated scans of the same prefix solely to mark structural root connectivity
block_resident_v2.candidate_boundary_not_implemented: Shared initial+write banks with per-query int64 visibility/prefix mappings; node/parameter-role grouped GEMM and block VJP; batch H; field-selective window decoding; lazy complete observation materialization. Must preserve selected-row semantics, zero/None, versions and exact continuation.

old_report_corrections_and_scope: docs/evidence/lh-static-structure-20261112.md is correctly fixed to fb83. Its 2*A and maximum 2132 source-MLP calls must not be reused as current source-v2 facts.
Read90/Full159/region94 are one historical runtime observation, not static constants. 394 is compiled direct source slots, not a minimum; 387 assumes additional initial input sharing not implemented.
EagerExecutor.run_ports first requires a matching Settle certificate. General PDG is available through __call__ record_run; it is not a PDG input silently accepted by run_ports.

Direct StaticKV._sources still keys on tuple(id(p) for p in transform.parameters()), which deduplicates aliases. Ordered factor slots can differ with an identical deduplicated list. Source-v2 already uses ordered slots and tests/test_column_sources.py 176-187 demonstrates this class of counterexample. No-factor LH176 material is unaffected; do not claim broad direct-anchor alias coverage.
Resident block outer scheduling must not be described as complete inner B*L tensorization. Matrix replication, repeated raw prefix materialization and serial device loops remain concrete boundaries.
